reviews.reason: The verified paper and publisher source package contain only the assembled Figure 1 PDF. Its artwork insets are 112x109 and 125x121 pixels, so they cannot establish the exact original WikiArt bytes, native 500-3000 pixel series, crop/border/color provenance, or full source-pixel distributions required by the frozen replication rule.

The paper's data-availability and WikiArt/public-domain statements do not establish byte identity. The source archive supplies composite surface plots and only tiny artwork insets, which cannot support the native resolution series or recover the original crop, borders, color management, and full empirical distributions; therefore no eligible replication run can occur.
